data.define: People who love the same show or band.

misuse.why: It means devoted fans of one thing.

native.tip: “fandom” = fã-clube. Exemplo: “The fandom loves this band.”
native.caption:
O que significa “fandom”?
“fandom” = fã-clube.
Exemplo: “The fandom loves this band.” (O "fandom" ama essa banda.)
